story.iWant: to quickly update my account balances
story.soThat: I can complete weekly updates in under 10 minutes

tasks.task: Create QuickBalanceUpdate component (AC: 1, 4) Create src/components/accounts/QuickBalanceUpdate.tsx Import useAccounts and useFlexiFacility hooks for data Display list of all debt accounts with name, type icon, and current balance Display flexi facility (if exists) with name and current balance Each balance displayed in an inline editable Input field Current balance pre-filled in each field Use shadcn/ui Card as container for the update view Use shadcn/ui Input for balance fields with ZAR formatting

Implement inline balance editing with auto-save (AC: 1, 2, 6) Create local state for each balance field value Implement onBlur handler that triggers save if value changed Implement onKeyDown handler for Enter key to trigger save Use debounce (500ms) to prevent excessive database writes Only trigger save if new value differs from original value Track which field is currently being edited for focus management

Create useDebouncedSave hook (AC: 2, 6) Create src/hooks/useDebouncedSave.ts Accept callback function and delay (default 500ms) Return debounced save function Cancel pending saves on unmount Export from src/hooks/index.ts

Implement save indicator feedback (AC: 2) Create src/components/accounts/BalanceUpdateRow.tsx sub-component Props: account (or flexi), onSave callback, showSavedIndicator Display "Saving..." during save operation Display "Saved" checkmark for 2 seconds after successful save Handle error state with red indicator Use lucide-react icons: Check (saved), Loader2 (saving), AlertCircle (error)

Implement balance validation (AC: 5) Create validation function: balance must be >= 0 and numeric Display inline validation error below field if invalid Prevent save operation for invalid values Clear error when user corrects the value Use Zod schema consistent with existing account validation

Implement last updated timestamp (AC: 3) Add lastUpdated?: string field to DebtAccount and FlexiFacility types if not present Update account/flexi record with ISO timestamp on save Display "Last updated: [date/time]" for each account row Format timestamp using date-fns and SA date format (DD/MM/YYYY HH:mm) Show "Never updated" if lastUpdated is null/undefined

Update account save functions (AC: 2, 3) Modify useAccounts hook to expose updateAccountBalance(id, balance) function Function updates only balance and lastUpdated fields (not full record) Modify useFlexiFacility hook to expose updateFlexiBalance(id, balance) function Ensure reactive updates via Dexie useLiveQuery

Integrate into DataEntryPage (AC: All) Add "Update Balances" button to DataEntryPage header Toggle between normal view and QuickBalanceUpdate view Or: Create as collapsible section at top of DataEntryPage Show FinancialSnapshot alongside for real-time total debt updates Ensure total debt in snapshot updates reactively as balances are saved

Write tests and verify (AC: All) Write unit tests for useDebouncedSave hook Write component tests for QuickBalanceUpdate Write component tests for BalanceUpdateRow Test validation error display and prevention Test save indicator state transitions Test debounce behavior (no save if unchanged) Run npm run test and ensure all tests pass Run npm run build and ensure no type errors

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given I have existing accounts When I click "Update Balances" Then I see a streamlined view with: List of all accounts with current balance displayed, Inline edit field for each balance (no modal/popup needed), Current balance pre-filled, Auto-save when I click away or press Enter
Given I update a balance When I change the value and move to next field Then the new balance is saved immediately (auto-save) And I see a brief "Saved" indicator next to the field
Given I update all balances When I'm done Then I can see timestamp of "Last updated: [date/time]" And total debt reflects new balances
Given I have a flexi facility When I view the quick update view Then I can also update the flexi facility current balance inline
Given I enter an invalid balance (negative number, non-numeric) When I try to save Then the field shows validation error and does not save
Given I make no changes to a field When I click away Then no save operation is triggered (debounce prevents unnecessary writes)

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR5: User can update account balances manually on weekly or monthly basis. FR51: User can complete weekly data update in under 10 minutes.

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: ADR-002 (Dexie.js): Partial updates via db.accounts.update(id, { balance, lastUpdated }). ADR-003 (big.js): Validate and store balance as string for precision. Component location: src/components/accounts/

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Inline editing: Click to edit balance fields directly. Form validation: Real-time feedback, error messages below field. Quick update UI: Card-based container with teal header, each account row shows: Type icon | Account Name | Balance Input | Status | Last Updated

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Story 2.6: Implement Quick Balance Update Flow. Fulfills FR5 and supports FR51 (10-minute updates). Implements inline editing with blur-to-save pattern.

doc.title: Epic 2 Technical Specification
doc.snippet: AC 2.6.1-2.6.6: Update Balances view, inline editable fields, auto-save on blur/Enter, "Saved" indicator, last updated timestamp, total debt reactive updates.

constraints.constraint: Follow ADR-002: Use Dexie db.accounts.update() for partial updates
Follow ADR-003: Store balance as string, use big.js for validation
Use shadcn/ui components: Card, Input, Button
Use lucide-react icons for status indicators
Files: kebab-case, Components: PascalCase, Hooks: use prefix
Use Vitest + React Testing Library + fake-indexeddb
Balanced Teal theme: primary teal-600 (#0d9488), success green-500, error red-500
Auto-save on blur with 500ms debounce, "Saved" indicator visible for 2 seconds
NFR-P2: Form inputs respond immediately (<100ms), auto-save non-blocking
Balance must be >= 0 and numeric, use Zod schema consistent with account.ts validation

interface.name: useDebouncedSave
interface.signature: <T>(saveFunction: (value: T) => Promise<void>, delay?: number) => (value: T) => void

tests.standards: Tests use Vitest with React Testing Library. Integration tests use fake-indexeddb/auto for IndexedDB mocking. Component tests follow existing patterns in tests/components/accounts/. Use renderHook for hook testing, render/screen/fireEvent/waitFor for component testing. Test async operations with act() and waitFor().
